label: Hot water cylinder (heated by heat pump)
description: Hot water cylinder whose heat input is supplied by a heat pump. Computes electricity input and annual tCO2e from delivered hot water heat.

inputs.label: Annual hot water heat delivered
inputs.help: Thermal energy delivered as hot water over a year (kWh thermal).

inputs.label: Heat pump COP
inputs.help: Coefficient of performance (heat out / electricity in).

inputs.label: Electricity carbon intensity
inputs.help: Grid carbon intensity used to convert kWh into emissions.
